name: Medieval Kingdoms Total War: 1212 AD
summary: Medieval Kingdoms 1212 AD is a comprehensive mod for the Total War: Attila game, transforming it into a medieval setting focused on the year 1212. It offers a highly detailed and immersive experience with numerous playable factions, unique units, and historically accurate features. The mod is popular among Total War fans as a potential vision of what a Medieval 3 title could be.
